title: lucuma glycyphloea
intro: Lucuma glycyphloea, commonly known as the lucuma or lucuma tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This plant is native to the Andean region and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of lucuma glycyphloea include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant protection, while its therapeutic actions include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of lucuma glycyphloea include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
